description: Find neighbourhood groceries (بقالات / تموينات) in Saudi Arabia from Dukkani's public directory, by district (حي) + city, by city, or by coordinates. Returns each grocery's name, city, distance (km, when known), an order_url (Dukkani order page; the customer sends the order on WhatsApp), a map_url and open (customers' open/closed confirmations of the last 3 hours, or null), plus nearest_url: the live «nearest grocery» radar for where the user is now. Groceries that use Dukkani and take orders in the app come first (on_dukkani=true). Use the Arabic district/city names when you have them (e.g. district «النهضة», city «عفيف»).

city.description: City, e.g. الرياض، جدة، عفيف، بريدة (Arabic preferred)

district.description: District / neighbourhood (حي), e.g. الياسمين، النهضة. Give the city too when you know it.

latitude.description: Optional: the user's latitude (only if they shared it)

name: find_groceries
title: دوّر بقالة قريبة — Find nearby groceries (Saudi Arabia)
